_readme: Accepted HIGH/CRITICAL advisories for `npm run check:dependency-audit:mobile` (run from the repo root).
Same contract as the web /.audit-allowlist.json — see its _readme for the field shapes and the rules.
Separate from the web allowlist ON PURPOSE: the two trees share almost nothing, and an accept reasoned
about a server code path means nothing inside an Expo bundle. Never paste an id between the two files
without re-arguing the reason for THAT tree.
Note the mobile gate covers the WHOLE tree, not just runtime deps: `--omit=dev` is inert under
`--package-lock-only` (verified 2026-08-07 — identical reports with and without it). That is the honest
posture for this tree anyway, since mobile's only devDependency is @babel/core.

accepted.reason: Quadratic-complexity DoS in LinkifyIt#match's scan loop. NO FIX EXISTS — the advisory range is <=5.0.1, i.e. every published version, and npm reports fixAvailable:false. Reached only via react-native-markdown-display@7.0.2 -> markdown-it@10.0.0, whose sole consumer is mobile/app/contracts/[id].jsx rendering a contract body. That text is authored by an operator in the CRM, not by an outside party, and the worst case is that the signing staff member's OWN phone stalls — there is no server, no shared process and no other tenant to affect. Re-decide if markdown rendering is ever pointed at member- or public-authored text.

Second quadratic-complexity DoS in the same package, via the mailto: validator scan loop. Identical reasoning, reachability and re-decide trigger as GHSA-22p9-wv53-3rq4 above: no fix published for any version, and the only call path is operator-authored contract text rendered on the staff device in mobile/app/contracts/[id].jsx.
